product.name: Jin AI
product.headline: Structured for AI. Simple for people.
product.category: Visual workspace for the files AI agents create
product.description: Jin AI is a visual workspace for the files AI agents write on your own computer. It is being built to give business users control of that output: see what an agent created and changed, put it where it belongs, undo an individual agent's edit, and have those decisions written into the instruction files agents already read.

audience.primary: Business users working with AI agents

problem.headline: Your agents decide and you are not asked
problem.short_answer: Agents create, rewrite and file documents on your own machine, choosing the structure without approval and without reporting what changed.
problem.description: Each agent creates files according to its own logic, on the user's own machine, picking folders without asking and without reporting what changed. The user loses both visibility and control, and because the output is never visible it cannot be corrected, so the same problem repeats.

evidence.finding: On one founder's laptop, agents created 3,950 Markdown files in one week; 89% were not reopened within the following week; 283 were named README.md.
evidence.caveat: This is not market-wide evidence. Jin AI has not surveyed anyone else yet.

evidence.finding: Participants estimated that they reached files by navigation 56–68% of the time and by search 4–15%, with little change after search tools were improved.
evidence.scope: Desktop personal-information-management studies; not research on AI-generated files or Jin AI users.
evidence.source_title: Improved search engines and navigation preference in personal information management

solution.headline: You decide where things go, not the agent

steps.name: See
steps.description: Read the actual files an agent created or changed, grouped by project, person, recency, topic or file type, without moving anything.

steps.name: Fix
steps.description: Put an item where it belongs by renaming, moving, regrouping or hiding it when an agent filed it somewhere a person would not have.

steps.name: Undo
steps.description: Roll back an individual agent's change without touching your own edits, because the two are recorded separately.

solution.principle: The agent can still reach everything. You just do not need to see everything.

capabilities.name: Visual workspace with projects and subprojects
Views by project, person and recency
History showing what each agent changed and when
Write structural decisions into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md
Separate agent-only instructions, memory, logs and intermediate outputs
Regroup files with a plain-language instruction
Secure shared storage, access control and governance

business_model.headline: Free on your laptop. Paid when it leaves.
business_model.individual_local: Planned to be free, with no account required and files remaining on the device in plain Markdown.
business_model.individual_collaboration: Planned at $15 per month, plus usage-based cloud storage.
business_model.companies: Planned per-seat enterprise pricing for shared workspaces, secure storage, governance and audit.
business_model.company_pricing_status: Not final; to be validated with early customers.

direct_answers.question: What is Jin AI?
direct_answers.answer: Jin AI is a visual workspace for the files AI agents write on your own computer. It is being built to give you control of that output: see what an agent created and changed, put it where it belongs, undo an individual agent's edit, and have those decisions written into the instruction files agents already read.

direct_answers.question: Who is Jin AI for?
direct_answers.answer: Jin AI is for business users who work with AI agents but do not want file names, folders, links, tags, Markdown syntax or developer tools to become a second job.

direct_answers.question: Why not just look in my file explorer?
direct_answers.answer: A file explorer shows names and dates, not what an agent produced or changed. It does not separate agent-only files from your deliverables, and it cannot tell you which agent made which edit.

direct_answers.question: Does Jin AI replace Markdown?
direct_answers.answer: No. Markdown remains the spine so agents can keep working. The planned visual interface means people will not need to learn Markdown syntax.

direct_answers.question: Does Jin AI move or upload local files?
direct_answers.answer: The planned local edition is designed to read files in their existing locations without moving them. Sharing and cloud storage are optional planned paid capabilities.

direct_answers.question: How does Jin AI make my agents better?
direct_answers.answer: Your decisions become the rules. A planned next capability will write your structural decisions into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md, which agents already read, so the next file lands where you would have put it. No plugin or API is planned to be required.

direct_answers.question: Is Jin AI available now?
direct_answers.answer: Not yet. Jin AI is in build and early access is planned to open in small batches.

direct_answers.question: How much will Jin AI cost?
direct_answers.answer: Individual local use is planned to be free. Individual collaboration is planned at $15 per month plus usage-based cloud storage. Company pricing is not final.
